auditScope: Uploaded report plus the 75 published observation pairs from the prior research pack. Not a direct audit of new implementation source code.

reportedAcceptance.rule: Accept regularized country-aware conversion when (1) slope>0, (2) leave-one-club-out MAE is at least 25 Elo better than global linear LOO MAE, (3) every target club country has ≥9 same-club pairs, (4) predicted ClubElo in [1000,2200], (5) Zemun/Mačva residuals retained (not dropped). Converted values labelled calibrated_from_published_rating, not verified ClubElo.

reportedSignedResidualDefinition: not stated in supplied report; do not infer bias direction without checking code

clubEloToQuality.notes: Monotonic ClubElo→internal team quality fitted to percentile anchors over the observed 485-club Elo range so weak and elite clubs are not flattened. Distinct from Opta and FIFA transforms. Parameters frozen with baseline.

findings: The report shows an aggregate improvement in matching the published ClubElo scale. It does not establish match-outcome calibration.
Serbia has the largest country MAE (44.99) and RMSE (61.82); the sample retains Zemun (181.40 absolute error) and Macva Sabac (96.39).
AVS raw FootballDatabase rating 1335 is 9 points below the Portuguese paired minimum of 1344. This is mild extrapolation and must be disclosed.
All five targets remain calibrated_from_published_rating. Their predicted ClubElo values are not direct ClubElo observations.
The linear ClubElo-to-quality transform uses chosen internal quality anchors. It is a game design mapping, not an empirically verified player or match rating.
The paired provider editions differ by four days (ClubElo 2026-10-08, FootballDatabase 2026-10-04). Report the date difference as a limitation.
requiredImplementationChecks: Verify each cross-validation fold refits all learned global and country terms using only training rows.
Document fixed versus tuned regularization and avoid choosing hyperparameters on the same holdout observations used to report final error.
Report all paired rows and residuals with a defined sign; keep known outliers.
Add per-target country sample support, input range, extrapolation and uncertainty limitations.
Freeze model coefficients and regularization/version identifiers in career baselines.
Use sensitivity refits to flag unstable targets; do not choose arbitrary offsets or output a fake confidence interval from MAE.
